parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set system services dhcp pool bas-local.template: set system services dhcp pool [parameter1] range [parameter2] to [parameter3]
set system services dhcp pool bas-local.command: set system services dhcp pool bas-local range 10.0.0.2 to 10.0.255.254

set system services dhcp network 10.0.0..explanation: 配置DHCP服务的网络地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: authentication-order
parameters.explanation: 系统认证顺序，none表示不进行认证。

parameters.name: accounting
parameters.explanation: 系统计费功能，none表示不进行计费。

set system services dhcp pool ipv4 range.template: set system services dhcp pool [parameter1] range [parameter2] to [parameter3]
set system services dhcp pool ipv4 range.command: set system services dhcp pool ipv4 range 10.0.0.2 to 10.0.255.254

set system services dhcp multicast-polic.template: set system services dhcp multicast-policy [parameter1] out bandwidth [parameter2] level-1 [parameter3] interface [parameter4]
set system services dhcp multicast-polic.command: set system services dhcp multicast-policy policy1 out bandwidth 10000 level-1 8000 interface ge-0/0/0

parameters.name: level-1
parameters.explanation: 多播策略的级别1带宽限制。

set interfaces virtual-template100 unit.template: set interfaces virtual-template[parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet pppoe-options pppoe-username [parameter3]
set interfaces virtual-template100 unit.command: set interfaces virtual-template100 unit 0 family inet pppoe-options pppoe-username chap
set interfaces virtual-template100 unit.explanation: 配置虚拟模板接口的PPPoE选项。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 pppoe ppp.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] pppoe pppoe-server bind [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 pppoe ppp.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 pppoe pppoe-server bind Virtual-Template100
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 pppoe ppp.explanation: 配置物理接口绑定到虚拟模板接口。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

parameters.name: virtual-template
parameters.explanation: 绑定的虚拟模板接口名称。

set routing-options multicast sparse-mod.explanation: 配置多播路由为稀疏模式。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet multicast
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet multicast

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set protocols igmp interface ge-0/0/0.0.explanation: 在指定接口上启用IGMP协议。

set system services dhcp bas access-type.template: set system services dhcp bas access-type [parameter1]
set system services dhcp bas access-type.command: set system services dhcp bas access-type layer2-subscriber
set system services dhcp bas access-type.explanation: 配置DHCP BAS访问类型为二层用户。

set system services dhcp bas default-dom.template: set system services dhcp bas default-domain authentication [parameter1]
set system services dhcp bas default-dom.command: set system services dhcp bas default-domain authentication ipv4
set system services dhcp bas default-dom.explanation: 配置DHCP BAS默认域的IPv4认证。

set system services dhcp multicast copy.template: set system services dhcp multicast copy [parameter1]
set system services dhcp multicast copy.command: set system services dhcp multicast copy by-session
set system services dhcp multicast copy.explanation: 配置DHCP多播复制方式为按会话。

set policy-options policy-statement poli.command: set policy-options policy-statement policy1 from protocol multicast
set policy-options policy-statement poli.explanation: 配置策略声明policy1的来源协议为多播。

set policy-options policy-statement poli.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] then bandwidth [parameter2] level [parameter3] [parameter4]
set policy-options policy-statement poli.command: set policy-options policy-statement policy1 then bandwidth 30000 level 1 20000
set policy-options policy-statement poli.explanation: 配置策略声明policy1的带宽和级别。

set policy-options policy-statement out.command: set policy-options policy-statement out from protocol multicast
set policy-options policy-statement out.explanation: 配置策略声明out的来源协议为多播。

set policy-options policy-statement out.command: set policy-options policy-statement out then permit
set policy-options policy-statement out.explanation: 配置策略声明out的动作允许。

set policy-options policy-statement out.command: set policy-options policy-statement out then bandwidth 1000
set policy-options policy-statement out then level 1
set policy-options policy-statement out.explanation: 配置策略语句中的级别参数。

set policy-options policy-statement out.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] then group [parameter2] source [parameter3]
set policy-options policy-statement out.command: set policy-options policy-statement out then group 235.1.1.1 source 1.1.1.1
set policy-options policy-statement out.explanation: 配置策略声明out的组和源地址。

set policy-options policy-statement out.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] then group [parameter2] source [parameter3]
set policy-options policy-statement out.command: set policy-options policy-statement out then group 236.1.1.1 source 2.1.1.1
set policy-options policy-statement out.explanation: 配置策略声明out的组和源地址。

set policy-options policy-statement out.command: set policy-options policy-statement out then bandwidth 2000
set policy-options policy-statement out.explanation: 配置策略语句中的带宽参数。
